<thought>To obtain the precursors, I first need the retrosynthetic template that matches the described intramolecular Michael cyclization (chalcone → flavanone). I will search the template catalog using only the bond changes, which should return the appropriate template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(Cc2ccccc2)C2=CC=CC=C12",
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
